title: An attacker who needs several backdoors gets caught sooner
caption: Chance of catching an attacker at least once when it must land several backdoors. Assumes attempts are independent and the attacker doesn't adapt, so it is an optimistic bound.
source: Marnick's data explorer (marnick-data-2, built 2026-11-02), view 'geom-campaign-safety'. Copied as exported; its generator isn't in the repo yet.

xAxis.name: backdoors the attacker has to land

yAxis.name: probability at least one of them is caught
